role: R17D observer arithmetic scheduling only; neither a new collision classifier nor the original course demo
reference: frozen R17D typed distribution and original R16 D plant; controller identical within each comparison
rule: Unchanged Coupled.update, normal release model, physical floors, margins, histories, persistence, clear, unsupported and fallback behavior. Compute time/mass correction table at reset (known mass only); materialize the six regression basis vectors once from the actually observed grip falling edge; compute each active 6-axis prediction once, never an episode-sized burst at release. No future sensor inputs, case IDs or collision truth. No changes to trained values or acceptance thresholds.
checks: All six returned residuals, all detection bits, every physics array and non-clock metric must be bit-identical to the unmodified R17D on every run; compare supported flag, age, features, C score/state, D channels, ratios and state in a separate per-tick digest probe. Zero and servo must delegate to R10 exactly. Check previously learned, known upper/lower directional floors and hysteresis using synthetic boundary tests including end-of-horizon semantics.
timing: Same pinned physical CPU, one BLAS thread, warmed model file cache, ABBA then BAAB over successive known loaded cases. Report reset separately, whole-cycle detector and controller+detector p99/max/number >1ms, process thread and wall, plus release phase. Never treat p99 as a hard deadline. For the schedule to count as a speed improvement, both independent loaded blocks must reduce post-release detector p99; otherwise report mixed.
disposition: Finite optimization study. Reproducing known R17D late false alarms is required for equivalence, not a performance pass for collision. Separate post-pulse recovery candidates are not included.
